description: Defines the MainActivityViewModel class responsible for managing UI state in the MainActivity of the Android app, including loading user data and theme settings.

classes.name: MainActivityUiState
classes.description: Sealed interface representing the different UI states for MainActivity, including loading and success states, with methods and properties to determine theme-related behavior.

methods.name: shouldKeepSplashScreen
methods.description: Returns true if the UI should keep showing the splash screen, i.e., when in Loading state.

methods.name: shouldUseDarkTheme
methods.description: Determines if a dark theme should be used based on system dark theme setting.
